t: You're standing at a bell barrow on Hampstead Heath, a rounded mound of earth rising from the grass. It is a prehistoric burial mound, and it is commemorated here as the resting place of Boudica. Boudica was a queen of the Iceni tribe, who led an uprising against the conquering Roman Empire in AD 60 or 61. The revolt failed, but she is remembered as a British national heroine, a symbol of the struggle for justice and independence. Take a moment here and picture the story behind the mound.
